title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-11-17
ranking_basis: Daily GitHub Trending star gains, sorted descending
ranking_explanation: The ten largest displayed daily star gains among the 15 repositories on the captured GitHub Trending daily page. Repository metadata and current default-branch commits were corroborated with GitHub REST API endpoints.
global_caveat: GitHub does not expose the exact sampling cutoff for the daily Trending window. The snapshot date is UTC; the page should not be interpreted as an exact midnight-to-midnight count. Star gains can change during the day.
corroboration: GitHub REST API /repos/{owner}/{repo} and /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}, plus GitHub Search API exact-repository queries for all ten entries; first-party README files were reviewed for the five highest-priority narration candidates.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time (UTC): 2026-11-17 17:31 UTC; Scope: Daily; Date range: 2026-11-17 through 2026-11-17; Ranking basis: Daily GitHub Trending star gains, sorted descending.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Today's strongest signal is the continued rise of agent-oriented developer workflows: coordination protocols, skills, review, and human-in-the-loop tooling appear repeatedly among the fastest risers. Univer leads the measured star-gain list, while AG-UI and PaperOrchestra show demand for reusable agent interfaces and multi-agent pipelines.

sections.title: dream-num/univer

enrichment.architecture_summary: The first-party README presents an extensible office SDK, starting with open-source Sheets and Docs and designed to connect with applications or agents.
enrichment.workflow: Embed the SDK in an application, then connect human-facing or agent workflows to the office capabilities.
enrichment.design_pattern: Extensible, embeddable SDK for integrating office capabilities into products.

sections.title: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
sections.description: An event-based protocol for connecting AI agents to user-facing applications.
sections.content: An event-based protocol for connecting AI agents to user-facing applications. Language: TypeScript; stars gained: +1,444; total stars: 19,879. Its strong daily gain highlights interest in standardizing streaming, state updates, tool calls, and human handoffs between agents and frontends.
sections.why_notable: Its strong daily gain highlights interest in standardizing streaming, state updates, tool calls, and human handoffs between agents and frontends.

enrichment.architecture_summary: An open, lightweight, event-based protocol uses a bidirectional stream to standardize how agents and user-facing clients exchange typed events.
enrichment.workflow: An agent emits events such as streamed output, tool activity, shared-state updates, or human handoffs; a client renders them without custom wiring for each agent framework.
enrichment.design_pattern: Framework-neutral event protocol with generated SDKs and schema-backed compatibility.

enrichment.design_pattern: Specialized-agent pipeline organized around the stages of paper production.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent workflows and reusable skills recur across several top gainers. AG-UI and Plannotator represent agent-to-application communication and human oversight; Alibaba Open Code Review shows hybrid deterministic and model-based code review. Univer and PaperOrchestra bring agent integration into office and research authoring, while Arcane supplies a non-agent infrastructure counterpoint. Python and TypeScript each appear in three listed repositories; Go appears in two; Shell and JavaScript in one each.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The daily snapshot is less about a single new model or framework than about making agents usable in real workflows: adding protocols, repeatable skills, safety checks, and human approval around them. At the same time, office software and self-hosted infrastructure remain visible non-coding-agent applications, suggesting the agent tooling wave is broadening into adjacent developer and productivity surfaces.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: GitHub Trending repositories today, https://github.com/trending?since=daily, captured at 2026-11-17 17:31 UTC. Corroboration: GitHub REST repository metadata and default-branch endpoints confirmed the listed repositories, totals, language/default branch, and commit SHAs; first-party READMEs were reviewed for the five highest-priority narration candidates. Daily gains rank the top ten from the 15 repositories returned in the captured page; the exact sampling cutoff is not exposed.
